logo_lab_composition_a1_description: Dense rows with horizontal words and upper anchors.
logo_lab_composition_a2_description: Vertical names follow the wide strokes; horizontal bridges connect them.
logo_lab_composition_a3_description: Alternating blocks of horizontal and vertical names.
logo_lab_composition_a4_description: Large names occupy the wide upper strokes; smaller names fill the gaps.
logo_lab_composition_a5_description: Generous spacing and a restrained hierarchy.
logo_lab_composition_a6_description: Fine mixed cells cover all four strokes.
logo_lab_composition_b1_description: Horizontal rows preserve the original seven-letter spacing.
logo_lab_composition_b2_description: Vertical names follow the stems of the seven letters.
logo_lab_composition_b3_description: Neighbouring letter zones alternate their preferred direction.
logo_lab_composition_b4_description: Large names anchor each letter; small names complete its outline.
logo_lab_composition_b5_description: Larger minimum type and generous spacing.
logo_lab_composition_b6_description: A fine mixed mosaic fills the complete wordmark.
logo_lab_composition_c1_description: Horizontal chords fill the disc around a transparent W.
logo_lab_composition_c2_description: Open horizontal rows and varied complete name lengths.
logo_lab_composition_c3_description: Balanced directional blocks surround the transparent W.
logo_lab_composition_c4_description: Vertical names fill the disc; horizontal names occupy the remaining pockets.
logo_lab_composition_c5_description: Large names anchor the outer sectors; small names follow the W boundary.
logo_lab_composition_c6_description: A dense mixed field fills the available disc, with a clear central W.
